purpose: Register focused public learning surfaces smaller than a canonical nested Room. Study Chambers inherit knowledge ownership and epistemic boundaries from an existing Room while giving one dense subject its own diagram, glossary, source trail and crosswalk.
admission_rule: Use a Study Chamber when the subject is too dense for a paragraph/card but does not own a durable project-wide class of knowledge.
Every chamber names its owning Room and return route.
A chamber may synthesize canonical holdings but must not become a second source of truth.
Diagrams must distinguish source-tradition structure from project interpretation and modern analogy.
Cross-tradition similarities remain typed as comparisons unless historical transmission is independently evidenced.

chambers.title: Yggdrasil & the Eddas
chambers.job: Teach the Eddic world-tree ecology, Odin wisdom/ordeal material, wells, Norns, gods, creatures and realm vocabulary; then expose bounded modern and Potatoverse comparisons.

chambers.title: Kabbalah, Qliphoth & Angelology
chambers.job: Separate biblical Tree/angel material, Jewish Kabbalah, Lurianic repair cosmology and later Hermetic/occult Qliphoth diagrams while making names, functions and boundaries learnable.
